WITH raw_data AS (
    -- 1. 提取两个周期的数据并打上周期标签
    SELECT
        platform,
        content_carrier,
        CASE
            WHEN published_at >= '2026-04-13 00:00:00+08' AND published_at <= '2026-04-17 23:59:59+08' THEN 'current_week'
            WHEN published_at >= '2026-04-06 00:00:00+08' AND published_at <= '2026-04-10 23:59:59+08' THEN 'last_week'
        END AS period,
        (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(interaction_snapshot ->> 'likes', '')::int, 0) +
            COALESCE(NULLIF(interaction_snapshot ->> 'shared', '')::int, 0) +
            COALESCE(NULLIF(interaction_snapshot ->> 'comments', '')::int, 0) +
            COALESCE(NULLIF(interaction_snapshot ->> 'collected', '')::int, 0)
        ) AS heat
    FROM dltest.dl_leshu.materials
    WHERE (published_at >= '2026-04-13 00:00:00+08' AND published_at <= '2026-04-17 23:59:59+08')
       OR (published_at >= '2026-04-06 00:00:00+08' AND published_at <= '2026-04-10 23:59:59+08')
),
agg_by_carrier AS (
    -- 2. 按平台、体裁、周期进行初步聚合
    SELECT
        platform,
        content_carrier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current_week' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cw_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'last_week' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lw_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current_week' THEN heat ELSE 0 END) AS cw_heat,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'last_week' THEN heat ELSE 0 END) AS lw_heat
    FROM raw_data
    GROUP BY platform, content_carrier
)
-- 3. 计算平台总数、分布占比及差距
SELECT
    platform AS "平台",
    content_carrier AS "内容载体",

    -- 数量分布及对比
    cw_count AS "本周数量",
    lw_count AS "上周数量",
    (cw_count - lw_count) AS "数量变化",

    -- 平台总数对比
    SUM(cw_count) OVER(PARTITION BY platform) AS "本周平台总数",
    SUM(lw_count) OVER(PARTITION BY platform) AS "上周平台总数",

    -- 占比计算
    ROUND(cw_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cw_count) OVER(PARTITION BY platform), 0), 2) || '%' AS "本周占比",
    ROUND(lw_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(lw_count) OVER(PARTITION BY platform), 0), 2) || '%' AS "上周占比",

    -- 热度对比
    cw_heat AS "本周总热度",
    lw_heat AS "上周总热度",
    (cw_heat - lw_heat) AS "热度变化"

FROM agg_by_carrier
ORDER BY platform, cw_count DESC
